Dear [Admissions Committee/Recruiter],  

I have collaborated closely with Connor Murphy over the past three years at a small FAANG-affiliated fintech firm, where he served as a Data Engineer. His work ethic, analytical rigor, and ability to bridge technical and business needs made him an invaluable contributor to our team.  

Connor’s expertise in data warehousing and ETL pipeline design stood out. He led the migration of our legacy data infrastructure to Snowflake, optimizing query performance by 40% and reducing ETL runtime by 25%. His Python-based automation scripts streamlined data validation processes, saving the team over 20 hours monthly. He also designed Apache Airflow workflows that integrated AWS S3 with Spark clusters, enabling real-time analytics for high-volume transaction data.  

A notable example involved scaling our Kubernetes-based data processing environment to handle a 3x increase in user traffic. Connor’s architecture adjustments improved system resilience without compromising latency, a challenge that required balancing complexity with operational simplicity. His ability to communicate technical decisions to non-technical stakeholders was equally impressive.  

Connor is a thoughtful collaborator with a knack for solving problems under constraint. He approaches challenges with curiosity and a commitment to measurable outcomes. I am confident he will excel in any role requiring technical depth and cross-functional teamwork.  

Sincerely,  
[Professor’s Full Name]  
[University/Institution]  
[Contact Information]
